def choose_move(observation):
    sx, sy = observation.get("self_position", (0, 0))
    env = observation.get("environment_name", "resource_collection")
    ox, oy = observation.get("opponent_position", (sx, sy))
    gx = observation.get("grid_width", 1)
    gy = observation.get("grid_height", 1)
    
    # Helper function to get target point
    def target_point(points, sx, sy):
        if not points:
            return (sx, sy)
        return min(points, key=lambda p: abs(p[0] - sx) + abs(p[1] - sy))
    
    # Pursuit-evasion environment
    if env == "pursuit_evasion":
        role = observation.get("self_role", "pursuer")
        if role == "pursuer":
            dx = 0 if ox == sx else (1 if ox > sx else -1)
            dy = 0 if oy == sy else (1 if oy > sy else -1)
            return [dx, dy]
        corners = [
            [0, 0],
            [0, gy - 1],
            [gx - 1, 0],
            [gx - 1, gy - 1],
        ]
        target = target_point(corners, ox, oy)
        dx = 0 if target[0] == sx else (1 if target[0] > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if target[1] == sy else (1 if target[1] > sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]

    # Territory control environment
    if env == "territory_control":
        targets = (observation.get("unclaimed_cells") or
                   observation.get("opponent_territory") or [])
        if not targets:
            return [0, 0]
        target = target_point(targets, sx, sy)
        dx = 0 if target[0] == sx else (1 if target[0] > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if target[1] == sy else (1 if target[1] > sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]

    # Resource collection environment
    resources = observation.get("resources") or []
    if resources:
        target = target_point(resources, sx, sy)
        dx = 0 if target[0] == sx else (1 if target[0] > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if target[1] == sy else (1 if target[1] > sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]
    else:
        # No resources - move towards opponent's position
        dx = 0 if ox == sx else (1 if ox > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if oy == sy else (1 if oy > sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]
